title: How often each gate's answer agrees with a person's placement
description: What GET /api/v1/gates/agreement answers and `ingestion gates agreement --json` prints. The label is each item whose newest side decision a person made. Each done answer of the quality gate on such an item is one comparison, read as the model gave it, before a floor turns a drop or a guess into review. A pass agrees with a placement on a side and a drop with a person's drop. The side guess agrees where it names the person's side, and a person's drop gives it nothing to compare. An unsure answer neither agrees nor disagrees.

labels.description: The items a person placed, by where the person placed each.

unanswered.description: The items a person placed that hold no done answer of the quality gate.

quality.description: The quality gate's verdict, pass, drop or unsure, beside the placement.

side.description: The quality gate's side guess, personal, fleet or unsure, beside the side a person placed an item on.

floor.description: The confidence at or above which the gate acts on the answer alone: the quality gate's drop, or the side guess.

by_confidence.description: Each band of the answer's confidence that holds a comparison, lowest first. A band holds from up to to, and to itself only in the top band.

by_connector.description: The comparisons on the items each connector sighted. An item that two connectors sighted counts under each.

by_model.description: The comparisons on each model's answers, by the model that answered, else the one asked for.

by_prompt_version.description: The comparisons on each prompt version's answers.

agreement.description: agreed over agreed and disagreed, and null where both are 0.

answers.description: How many comparisons paired each answer with each placement.

label.description: The person's placement: personal, fleet or drop.
